why: One source of truth for the store buttons on every page (owner 18 Nov 2026: no waitlist; 'look for it in the Apple App Store and Google Play ... flip a switch'). null = 'coming soon' text for that store; a URL = that store's official badge linking to the listing. Set by hand the day a store approves: npm run store:set -- --ios <url> --play <url>, then land the PR as usual.
es_listing_spanish_legal_why: ON since the owner's yes on 20 Nov 2026 (commit f26135d): the es-MX store listing links the Spanish legal pages (/es/privacidad, /es/terminos), and the release gate fails if store/listing-es.md disagrees. To go back to the English pages marked (en inglés): npm run store:set -- --es-legal off, then land the PR as usual.
app_store_pt_why: Her App Store Connect provider token (App Analytics > Campaigns): with it, each page's ct= tag on the App Store link is credited to that page. null until she sets it; the ct tag is on the links either way.
custom_pages_why: Apple custom product pages (App Store Connect, 21 Nov 2026). paths: exact landing pages (a trailing slash means that folder's index.html) whose App Store link opens the page (?ppid=), next to the page's own ct= tag. prefixes: a whole folder (the Spanish site). waiting_on_pr85: pages PR #85 adds; the test fails once they exist so they move to paths. Unlisted pages link the default product page. Only used once app_store_url is set.
